entries.44010887313d4a59: A transportation company headquartered in Fukuyama City, Hiroshima Prefecture, that carries companies' cargo over a nationwide transport network.
entries.44887d7c2900d03a: It is a business that handles customs clearance and international freight. It consists of the international transportation business, the international freight forwarding business and the customs brokerage business. The international freight forwarding business is conducted by the company, Fukuyama Transporting Global and 25 other subsidiaries. It handles import and export cargo at 15 customs clearance offices nationwide, and has subsidiaries in Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia and elsewhere. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥15,244 million.
entries.4c9742bc25519fb0: It is a business mainly engaged in chartered operations within domestic transportation. Because the same company conducts it as the Transportation Business, it is treated as a segment integrated with the Transportation Business in the explanation of its business. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥27,807 million.
entries.87774e77f25c0dd2: It is a domestic freight transportation business that carries companies' cargo through a nationwide network of bases. The company and its 22 subsidiaries, including Kyushu Fukuyama Transporting and Tokyo Fukuyama Transporting, work together to conduct freight automobile transportation and freight forwarding, building a transportation network across Japan. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥244,573 million, the largest of the five segments. Harbor transportation is conducted by the subsidiary Kochi Fukuyama Transporting, which also carries out businesses incidental to transportation, such as collecting payments for goods on behalf of clients.
entries.cb8dfe9c415d881b: It is a business mainly engaged in 3PL (outsourcing of logistics as a whole), which undertakes clients' warehousing and storage operations at cargo storage facilities. The warehousing business is conducted by the company, Tokyo Fukuyama Transporting and five other subsidiaries, and the distribution processing business is conducted by the company and 13 subsidiaries. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥23,700 million.
entries.e28d452faedac57f: This is a category not included in the reportable segments, and includes real estate leasing, merchandise sales, and worker dispatch (outsourced operations). The company also conducts convenience store, non-life insurance agency, bowling, travel, security and electrical equipment construction businesses. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥7,256 million.
